title: Programs call psionic operators 'pink assets'
summary: Michael Herrera tells of Programs call psionic operators 'pink assets', about present at unspecified legacy programs, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And granted, that is something that has been communicated to me is yes, that some of the programs refer to them as that.

plain: Michael Herrera, a man who says he saw a huge UFO in the Indonesian jungle, says a man named Jake Barber told him something about secret long-running programs said to deal with non-human craft. According to Herrera, some of these programs use the nickname "pink assets" for psionic operators, people said to use the power of their minds on their work. If true, it would mean hidden programs have their own code words for people with psychic abilities.
